title: CCTV Footage Released Showing White House Correspondents' Dinner Shooting Suspect
detail: New CCTV footage released showing suspect Cole Allen, 31, firing at a law enforcement agent outside the White House Correspondents' Dinner on April 25–26. The footage provides visual evidence in the ongoing investigation into the high-profile attack that prompted evacuation of President Trump, Vice President Vance, and Cabinet members. One law enforcement officer was shot but survived; Allen was arrested at the scene.
